The Docker attributes processor enriches traces, metrics, logs, and profiles with
Docker container metadata, keyed by the `container.id` resource attribute. It keeps
a live in-memory cache of containers, kept fresh by the Docker events stream and
self-healed by on-demand inspects.

> **Status: under development.** This component is a scaffold; configuration and
> enrichment behavior are being implemented incrementally. See
> `dockerattributesprocessor-DESIGN.md` for the design.
